findings.summary: Change detection is type-correct and cannot fire spuriously on an unchanged save.
findings.detail: Every restart-required setting is a numeric config.Limits property assigned before the comparison: SourceArtifactLimitBytes/DerivedArtifactLimitBytes/RenderCacheQuotaBytes/ArtifactStorageQuotaBytes via byteLimitToBytes (Number), MaxImageDimensionPixels/RenderCacheTtlMinutes/TerminalProvenanceRetentionDays via parseInt. The snapshot reads the same config.Limits[key] from the freshly fetched JSON (number), so the strict !== compares number to number; the byte round-trip (display -> byteLimitToBytes) is exact for values that are multiples of the field step, which the persisted values are. The snapshot is taken at the top of the getPluginConfiguration callback, before config.Sonarr.Enabled (the first mutation), and the comparison runs after the last config.Limits write and before the update request.
